extracted.intended_audience: research mathematicians preparing/submitting manuscripts to Compositio Mathematica
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for authors preparing and submitting research manuscripts to the journal Compositio Mathematica, describing scope, required standards, accepted article types, and submission procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and subject matter
rubrics_metrics.description: Compositio Mathematica publishes first-class research papers that traditionally focus on the mainstream of pure mathematics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The journal has a broad scope which includes the fields of algebra, number theory, topology, algebraic and analytic geometry and global analysis. Papers on other topics are welcome if they are of broad interest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality and originality requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: All contributions are required to meet high standards of quality and originality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should be 'first-class' research papers suitable for a prestigious, well-established journal; novelty and high scholarly standard are expected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted article types and Gold OA classification
rubrics_metrics.description: We accept the following types of articles: Research Article*; for the purposes of Gold Open Access funding, this journal considers these article types to be research articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If publishing Gold OA, all or part of the publication costs for these article types may be covered by one of the agreements Cambridge University Press has made to support open access. (Note: the page indicates other article types may be listed; consult the full 'Author instructions' for the complete list.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission system account and pre-submission steps
rubrics_metrics.description: You will need an account for the submission system, which is separate to your Cambridge Core account.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For login and submission support, visit the submission and support pages. Authors should review the journal's author instructions, particularly the 'preparing your materials' page, before submitting a manuscript and then proceed to the external submission system.
